{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Casting {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} makes you {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, but your {c_important}Evade{/c} Cooldown is increased by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Evading{/c} while {c_important}Dark Shroud{/c} is active leaves behind an explosion that deals {if:SF.IsMythic}{c_number}{else}{c_random}{/if}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Shadow damage and Pulls In enemies.{if:SF.IsMythic}{/c_mythic}{/if}
